title: questlogframe
summary: MSUI's rule-seated quest-log book retains the full SMSG_QUEST_QUERY_RESPONSE detail model, exposes all 20 descriptor slots through Benilla's six-row wheel offset, groups positive AreaTable and negative QuestSort headers with exact plus/minus folding, preserves selection by quest identity, colors rows with exact difficulty bands, renders objectives plus a scrollable description/reward pane, uses the server wall clock for timed countdowns, implements permanent manual and five-minute automatic watches, and has a law-seated abandon dialog. The shared Quest renderer now consumes the observer-resolved registered QuestLogFrame or QuestFrame panel seat according to its active mode. The current book furniture is now present as well: the Common-Input-Border quest-count pill, sort-tab-backed All collapse control, red/green Track Quest indicator, exact 300x261 detail viewport, overflow-only detail scrollbar, and the authored Abandon/Share/Exit bottom row all take their seats from QuestFrameUiLaw. Share remains the same stub as current Benilla. Focused quest-log checks pass; live visual/input verification remains outstanding.

openItems.text: List shows only the first 6 quests with no scroll offset, wheel, or scrollbar - quests 7..20 are unreachable in the log UI
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: Added the six-row faux-scroll offset, wheel ownership over the authored list rect, and exact 0..14 clamp so every one of the 20 quest slots is reachable.

openItems.text: No zone/category headers or collapse state on the list; current Benilla now synthesizes ZoneOrSort headers and preserves selection across header regrouping.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: Retained signed ZoneOrSort from the full query response; positive ids resolve through AreaTable, negative ids through QuestSort. QuestFrameUiLaw owns ordinal grouping, six-row fold icon seats, and visible-entry scroll clamping; runtime keeps collapse state by title and selection by quest id.

openItems.text: No quest level or difficulty coloring on title rows (reference QuestDifficultyColor law)
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: QuestFrameUiLaw now owns the exact QuestDifficultyColor/GetDifficultyColor banding (including the shared level-dependent green range), fed by the corrected full quest-template decoder.

openItems.text: Detail pane has no per-objective progress lines (kill/item counters with done-coloring) - a single cached progress string with a placeholder fallback stands in
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: Replaced the four-byte-early query shortcut with the full 5875 fixed-count parser and render each occupied creature/GO/item objective from template quads plus packed 6-bit descriptor counters or live carried-item counts, with grey completed lines and suffixes.

openItems.text: No rewards section (items/money/spell) in the log detail pane
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: The full template decoder now retains fixed and choice item arrays, signed money, and reward spell. The rule-owned 305x250 detail viewport scrolls through objective text, objective lines, description, item grids, money coins, and reward-spell icon/name; template-backed reward items resolve their real display icon and shared tooltip.

openItems.text: No quest-watch tracking (SHIFT-click watch toggle, on-screen tracker)
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: Shift-left-click now follows the current chat-wins fork (insert bare title when chat edit is open, otherwise toggle an id-stable manual watch), enforces the exact five-watch/objective guards, draws row checkmarks, and renders the bare 30-line tracker from the rule-owned MinimapCluster seat with exact title/objective gaps and completion colors.

openItems.text: Abandon sends immediately with no ABANDON_QUEST confirmation popup
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: Abandon now pins the click-time quest id/title and opens the shared-era Yes/No wording; the rule owns the centered 320x72 popup seat, text and button rectangles, Escape cancels, and only Yes sends then plays igQuestLogAbandonQuest.

openItems.text: Share Quest button is permanently disabled (no quest push) - matches Benilla's own v1 stub, noted for completeness
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: Current Benilla explicitly names party share/push as a v1 stub and authors QuestLogPushQuestButton with an unconditional OnLoad Disable. MSUI's law-seated disabled Share Quest button is therefore current parity; quest-push protocol work is not required by this snapshot.

2026-08-21: Added CMSG_QUERY_TIME/SMSG_QUERY_TIME_RESPONSE, a monotonic server-wall-clock sample, the exact absolute deadline minus server time minus one rule, failed/timer-zero gates, and the frozen strict-threshold two-unit SecondsToTime formatter. The separate current-Benilla QuestTimerFrame now renders all live timers in log order and opens/selects the owning quest on click.

openItems.text: Current Benilla's automatic five-minute quest watch on objective progress (including timed-watch eviction/expiry without evicting manual watches) is not yet implemented; MSUI currently supports permanent manual Shift-click watches only.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: Kill, item and objective-complete progress now arm or re-arm a 300-second automatic watch. Existing manual watches have no expiry and are never downgraded or evicted; a full list evicts only the auto watch nearest expiry, while all-manual lists reject the automatic addition.

openItems.text: Live-verify the current quest-count pill, All collapse tab, Track Quest indicator, corrected detail viewport, overflow-only detail scrollbar, and Abandon/Share/Exit row at representative gameplay scales and empty/partial/full quest states.

Live-verify the shared quest renderer beside another registered left panel: QuestLogFrame and the NPC QuestFrame must each consume the resolved panel seat while the centered abandon dialog stays display-centered.
